description: This Dart file implements an API client class for a Kindle clone frontend project, providing methods for HTTP GET and POST requests, handling content types, base URL resolution, and CORS headers.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A singleton API client class providing methods for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, raw HTML) with configurable base URL and headers, handling JSON and HTML content types.

methods.name: ApiClient._
methods.description: Private named constructor for singleton pattern.

methods.name: _baseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the base URL using settings or default configuration.

methods.name: _client
methods.description: Creates and returns a new HttpClient instance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request, handles JSON and HTML responses, applies headers including CORS settings.

methods.name: postJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with a JSON payload, handles response parsing.

methods.name: getRawHtml
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request expecting HTML content, returns raw HTML string.
